content.name: Mei Lin Chen
content.title: DevOps Lead
content.summary: DevOps lead with 17 years in Sydney across data centres, game studios, banking and health. Leads a team of nine running hybrid AWS and on-premises infrastructure for an electronic health-record vendor used by 320 clinics. Previously helped a mutual bank meet APRA CPS 234 expectations for its delivery pipeline.

experience.title: Linux Systems Engineer
bullets: Built and maintained Red Hat and CentOS hosts for 70 co-location and managed-hosting customers.
Wrote Bash and Perl tooling for provisioning that cut new-server handover from five days to two.
Worked rotating shifts in the network operations centre and handled first response for hardware and power faults.

experience.title: Build and Release Engineer
bullets: Ran nightly builds for three console and mobile titles, managing a farm of 40 build machines.
Halved full build time from eight hours to four by introducing distributed compilation and caching.
Automated certification submission packages for console platform holders, ending last-minute manual packaging before launches.

experience.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
bullets: Designed the bank's first cloud landing zone on AWS with separate accounts, guardrails and centralised logging.
Built pipeline controls (peer review, signed artefacts, change records) used as evidence for APRA CPS 234 information security reviews.
Moved internet banking releases from quarterly weekend outages to fortnightly daytime releases using blue-green deployment.
Led a team of four engineers during the mobile banking app rebuild.

experience.title: DevOps Lead
bullets: Lead nine engineers running hybrid AWS and on-premises infrastructure for an EHR product used in 320 GP and specialist clinics.
Delivered a multi-region disaster-recovery design that met a one-hour recovery time objective in three consecutive tests.
Reduced hosting costs by $640,000 a year by consolidating Kubernetes clusters and retiring legacy virtual machines.
Aligned patching and backup practice with the ASD Essential Eight, reaching Maturity Level Two for six of the eight strategies.

achievements.title: Panel speaker, Sydney DevOps meetup
achievements.detail: Discussed running regulated workloads in public cloud with peers from banking and government.

achievements.title: Mentor, women in infrastructure programme
achievements.detail: Mentored five early-career engineers over three intakes.

interests: Mentoring at a girls' coding camp
